name: Megacave
summary: Caveman in Classical Chinese (文言文): subjects omitted where recoverable, verbs first, classical particles (之、乃、為、其、則、故、以) instead of connective phrases — far fewer characters on screen. Same never-touch floor as hub.caveman: code, commands, paths, API names and error strings stay in their original script verbatim; negations (不、非、勿、未、毋) and Arabic numerals never drop; ambiguous clauses fall back to 白話; warnings, irreversible actions, questions and confused users get plain prose. Upstream sets disable-model-invocation: only explicit /megacave or /caveman wenyan runs it; persists until "stop caveman" or "normal mode". Upstream reports honestly: shorter on screen, small noisy token savings (9% median fewer, single-run snapshot, 12% more to 39% fewer); no quality claim. For readers of Classical Chinese wanting terse replies; not a translation tool. Verbatim from JuliusBrussee/caveman skills/megacave at the pinned commit (SKILL.md + README only). Apache-2.0.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 文言文版的 caveman：主语可推断则省略，动前宾后，以之、乃、為、其、则、故、以等实词代替连接短语——屏幕字符大幅减少。与 hub.caveman 语音同样的不可触碰底线：代码、命令、路径、API 名与错误串以原文字符逐字保留；否定词（不、非、勿、未、毋）与阿拉伯数字绝不省略；有两种读法的子句回落白話，安全警告、不可逆操作、向用户提问或用户困惑时回到完整散文或用户语言。上游声明 disable-model-invocation，仅在显式 /megacave 或 /caveman wenyan 时使用；模式持续到 "stop caveman" 或 "normal mode"。上游如实报告：屏幕更短，token 节省小且有噪声——单次快照中位数约省 9%，区间从多 12% 到少 39%，无质量等价声明。适合能读文言文且希望简短回复的人；不是翻译工具，也不适用于面向其他读者的散文。自 JuliusBrussee/caveman skills/megacave 钉住 commit 逐字携带（SKILL.md 与 README，不含仓库 CLI/engine 运行时）。许可证 Apache-2.0。

permissionsNote: The upstream SKILL.md declares no allowed-tools; any tool use is the host's decision. The entry carries pure conversational style guidance: no scripts, no network, no credential paths (both carried files read in full at listing time). Upstream sets disable-model-invocation, so the skill never auto-loads; the host only runs it on an explicit user command. Apache-2.0: the LICENSE carried at the entry root is the upstream repository's canonical text.
